# Prompt: ops-runbook-readiness

**Skill id:** `ops-runbook-readiness`

Runbooks, on-call context, and incident readiness.

---

Operations runbook readiness

## When to use
New service or operational change.

## MUST
- Document dashboards, alerts, rollback, and escalation paths.
- Define SLO/SLI touchpoints if applicable.
- Keep customer-visible comms templates ready.

## Verification
- [ ] Runbook location linked from service README or catalog
